title: Story premise ENT038: The Sock-Drawer Northern Lights
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (miniature adventure). Hook: The sky changes every time the drawer opens. Takeaway/theme: A mystery can have a small, local source.
description: A tiny explorer seeks a colorful glow at the back of a sock drawer, but every opening floods the scene with harsh light and rearranges the terrain. They mark a path with paired socks, wait for the drawer to settle, and find an original glow-in-the-dark star patch casting the mysterious colors.
